senses.gloss:
(डु ञ्) डुमिञ् r. 5th cl. (मिनोति मिनुते)
To cast, to throw, to throw about, to scatter.

r. 1st and 10th cls. (मयति माययति)
1 To go, to move.
2 To know.
(टु, ङ्) टु मीङ् r. 4th cl. (मीयते)
To part with life, to die.
(ञ्^1) मीञ् r. 9th cl. (मीनाति मीनीते)
To hurt, to injure, to kill.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.
